name: Poland — employment contract (umowa o pracę)

changelog.summary: Pay kept for sick days is the employer's sick pay (art. 92 KP): outside the ZUS contribution bases, in the health contribution base (uswiadczenia art. 81 ust. 5) and taxed; before, it was refused. Refused: sick pay at an employer that pays ZUS benefits itself (paysZusBenefits), whose payroll benefit from day 34 is not separated, and paid maternity leave.

Pay kept for sick or maternity leave days (a leave pay rule) is refused: sick pay (art. 92 KP) and sickness or maternity benefits are not subject to social insurance contributions, and whether the health contribution is due on employer sick pay was not settled from the act. Before, they were charged ZUS contributions as ordinary salary.

Corrects an error: the Labour Fund / Solidarity Fund answer for partial months (labourFundPartialMonth) is now ignored in a full month, where the month's pay alone decides (ustawa o rynku pracy art. 259 ust. 1); before, an answer left on NOT_DUE or DUE overrode it.

2026: minimum wage 4,806 zł, pension/disability limit 282,600 zł, FP+FS 2.45 %, FGŚP 0.10 %; PIT 12 % / 32 % above 120,000 zł with the 300 zł monthly reduction; health 9 % capped at the 2021-rules advance.

employer.description: The employer pays ZUS sickness and maternity benefits itself as płatnik zasiłków (more than 20 insured): its payroll then pays ZUS benefits from day 34 of sickness, which this template does not separate from sick pay, so paid sick leave is refused

Accident insurance rate notified by ZUS, as a fraction (e.g. 0.0167 for 1.67 %); payers reporting up to 9 insured pay 50 % of the year's highest group rate (ustawa wypadkowa art. 28; range 0.40-8.12 %, usus art. 22 ust. 1 pkt 4)

employee.description: The employee's statement on reducing the advance (PIT-2, updof art. 31b): by 1/12 (300 zł), 1/24 (150 zł) or 1/36 (100 zł) of the 3,600 zł tax-reducing amount, or none

Monthly costs of earning income (updof art. 22 ust. 2): 250 zł, 300 zł when living in another locality without a separation allowance (statement, art. 32 ust. 7), or none at the employee's request (art. 32 ust. 6)

Exemption claimed by statement (updof art. 31a ust. 8): relief for returning to Poland (art. 21 ust. 1 pkt 152), for families with four or more children (pkt 153) or for working seniors (pkt 154); the under-26 relief (pkt 148) applies from the birth date. All share the 85,528 zł yearly limit (ust. 44)
The employee asked for advances without the under-26 relief (updof art. 32 ust. 6)

No Labour Fund / Solidarity Fund contribution: woman aged 55+ or man aged 60+, 36 months after maternity/parental/childcare leave, 12 months for a hired 50+ or referred under-30 unemployed person (ustawa o rynku pracy art. 261-264)

For a partial month: whether the pay, converted to a full month, reaches the minimum wage so the Labour Fund / Solidarity Fund contribution is due (ustawa o rynku pracy art. 259 ust. 1); ignored in a full month, where the month's pay decides

No FGŚP contribution: woman aged 55+ or man aged 60+, 36 months after maternity/parental/childcare leave, or 12 months for certain hired unemployed persons (ustawa o ochronie roszczeń pracowniczych art. 9a-9c)

steps.message: Polish payroll is monthly: the pay period must be a whole calendar month
Paid maternity leave is not supported by this template: the maternity benefit (zasiłek macierzyński) paid through payroll is not modelled
Sick pay is not supported for an employer that pays ZUS benefits itself: from day 34 its payroll pays the ZUS sickness benefit, which has no health contribution and is not separated from sick pay
Pre-tax deductions are not supported by this template (PPK and other deductions are not modelled)

Partial month below the minimum wage: whether the Labour Fund contribution is due depends on the pay converted to a full month (ustawa o rynku pracy art. 259 ust. 1), so set the employee's labourFundPartialMonth

steps.label: Labour Fund and Solidarity Fund (FP + FS)
Revenue exempt from income tax (updof art. 21 ust. 1 pkt 148, 152-154)

limitations: Employment contracts (umowa o pracę) paid monthly in PLN in 2026, one payment per payer per month: a second run in the same month would apply the costs and the 300 zł reduction again. Rules follow the payment date (revenue is taxed and insured when paid).

The 282,600 zł pension/disability limit, the 120,000 zł threshold and the 85,528 zł exemption limit are tracked per payer from this template's posted runs; amounts from other payers or from before adopting the template are not known.

The 2021-rules cap on the health contribution uses this payer's taxable income since the start of the year for the 85,528 zł threshold of the 2021 scale; for employees with exempt revenue this understates the 2021 income (it only matters in low-pay months after high earlier income). With a 1/24 or 1/36 statement the 2021 reduction of 43.76 zł is still applied.

Sex is not recorded, so the 55/60 age exemptions from the Labour Fund, Solidarity Fund and FGŚP are entered per employee; whether a partial month reaches the minimum wage for the Labour Fund is entered per employee.

Not modelled: PPK, 50 % author's costs, the bridging-pension fund (FEP), the higher costs for several employment relationships (art. 22 ust. 2 pkt 2 and 4, settled in the annual return), the joint/single-parent statements (art. 32 ust. 3), work abroad (art. 32 ust. 9), ZUS sickness and maternity benefits paid by the employer as płatnik (refused), and benefits in kind spread over several months; employees with pre-tax deductions are refused.

Leave pay rules: pay kept for sick days is the employer's sick pay (wynagrodzenie chorobowe, art. 92 KP), outside the ZUS bases, in the health base (uswiadczenia art. 81 ust. 5) and taxed. The rule pays a percentage of salary; the statutory 80% is of the average pay of the last 12 months less 13.71%, so the amount may differ.
Contributions are rounded to the grosz, half up, per line; the tax base and the advance to the whole złoty (Ordynacja art. 63); the 2021-rules cap is not rounded (ZUS example 37).
Status LAW_DERIVED: values are cited from the acts; one case reproduces ZUS's worked example of the health cap and two the net pay published for 2026.
